about: Passable corridors through otherwise impassable land (lon, lat waypoints). Inside a mask, land is impassable except within width_deg/2 of a route polyline, plus each region's settlement. Built by tools/world_regions.py (W3): except_keys = the regions whose land the mask leaves alone; width_deg 0.8 (2026-10-19, was 0.6: wider for margin over the 1 u land band on each side; world_regions check measures the width in pathfinding cells); adrar extended to Nema so it leaves the mask. W4: the Nile valley is a route ('nile') instead of whole except_keys regions, so Egypt's Western Desert and Nubia are masked and darb_al_arbain is a real corridor; 'arabia' (Nefud, Najd, Rub' al Khali, the Jordan / Hejaz desert) with the hajj and Najd roads; 'persia' (Dasht-e Kavir, Dasht-e Lut) boxes without routes (the Khorasan road runs north of the Kavir, Kerman - Zahedan south of the Lut: land round the boxes stays passable). W5: 'turan' (Karakum, Kyzylkum) with the Amu Darya, Syr Darya, Khiva - Bukhara and Bukhara - Merv - Mashhad roads; 'thar' (the Thar core: the Indus, the Sindh - Gujarat edge and the Rann stay outside) with the Sukkur - Jaisalmer - Jodhpur road; 'hindu_kush' (Kabul - Kunduz range, Nuristan) with the Khawak and Bamiyan passes (the Khyber and Bolan lie outside the box; Nepal and the Himalayan foothills are left alone, Tibet is still filler). 'arctic' (north of the Arctic circle, east of the White Sea) has no routes: impassable tundra. W6: 'inner_asia' (one mask: Xinjiang, Tibet, Mongolia and Northwest China each touch several deserts and a region sits in one mask only) = Taklamakan, Tibetan plateau, Himalaya north slope, Qilian Shan, Gobi, Badain Jaran, Tengger; routes: the Hexi corridor to Hami, the Khotan Darya across the Taklamakan, the Kalgan - Urga tea road, Xining - Lhasa, Lhasa - Kathmandu (Kuti pass), Leh - Gartok. W7: 'australia' (the interior deserts, no routes: no interior road in 1805; the Murray-Darling lies outside the boxes).

sahara.except: the Maghreb coastal regions north of the Atlas and the Atlantic islands; the Nile valley is the 'nile' route

arabia.except: Yemen, Oman, Mesopotamia (Tigris / Euphrates), the Levant coast, Persia, Egypt; the boxes leave out the Gulf coast (al-Hasa, Bahrain, Qatar, the Trucial coast)

persia.except: nothing: the boxes keep clear of the settlements and the roads round the deserts

turan.except: Persian Khorasan (in the 'persia' mask); the boxes leave out the Khiva, Bukhara, Merv and Syr Darya oases and the Caspian coast

thar.except: Gujarat (a sliver at the box corner)

arctic.except: nothing: no settlement lies north of the Arctic circle; tundra wasteland (EU4 style) that also keeps the pathfinding polygon stream under 2^21 words (the Arctic coast is the longest in Asia)

inner_asia.except: one mask, since a region sits in one mask only. Boxes: the Taklamakan (2; the Tarim oasis rings Kashgar - Aksu - Kucha - Korla and Yarkand - Khotan - Keriya - Cherchen - Charklik stay outside), the Tibetan plateau (Changtang, Aksai Chin, Kunlun, Hoh Xil; the Tsangpo valley, Kham, the Qaidam and Ladakh stay outside), the Himalaya north slope, the Qilian Shan (2), the Gobi (2), the Badain Jaran and the Tengger. Nepal, Kashmir and Awadh (box edges) are left alone

australia.except: New South Wales (a sliver at the box corner). Boxes: the Great Sandy, Gibson, Little Sandy, Great Victoria and Tanami deserts (west), the Simpson, the Sturt Stony desert and Lake Eyre (east). The coasts stay passable: the east coast, Port Jackson, Port Phillip, the Murray-Darling, the south-west (Swan River, King George Sound), the Nullarbor coast, the Pilbara, the Kimberley, Arnhem Land and the Gulf of Carpentaria; Van Diemen's Land is outside
